name: RiskManager with InfoPanel and Support
summary: This EA is a risk management utility with an informational panel that monitors account risk metrics and provides support functionality. It does not open trades on its own but rather assists traders in managing exposure, tracking drawdown, and visualizing key account statistics through an on-chart info panel.
summary_zh: 该EA是一款风险管理工具，配备信息面板和辅助功能，用于监控账户风险指标。它不自行开仓交易，而是协助交易者管理风险敞口、追踪回撤，并通过图表上的信息面板可视化关键账户统计数据。
strategy_analysis: 该EA作为风险管理工具而非交易策略，其核心功能是实时监控账户的风险敞口和资金状态。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不会自行开仓；它被动地跟踪当前持仓的风险指标如保证金使用率、浮盈浮亏和最大回撤。出场条件同样不适用，但可能提供一键平仓或止损调整的辅助功能。仓位管理方面，它可能根据预设的风险参数建议仓位大小或发出超限警告。资金管理是其核心功能，通过计算每笔交易风险占比、总敞口比例和账户净值变化来帮助交易者控制整体风险。信息面板以可视化方式展示所有关键数据，使交易者能够快速做出风险管理决策。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA functions as a risk management utility rather than a trading strategy, with its core purpose being real-time monitoring of account risk exposure and capital status. Entry conditions are not applicable since the EA does not open trades on its own; it passively tracks risk metrics on existing positions such as margin usage, floating P&L, and maximum drawdown. Exit conditions are similarly not applicable, though it may provide support features like one-click close or stop-loss adjustment assistance. For position sizing, it likely suggests lot sizes or issues warnings based on pre-configured risk parameters such as maximum risk per trade or total exposure limits. Money management is its central function, calculating per-trade risk percentages, total exposure ratios, and account equity changes to help traders maintain control over overall risk. The info panel visualizes all critical data, enabling traders to make quick risk management decisions at a glance.

parameters.name: MaxRiskPercent
parameters.description: 每笔交易最大风险百分比

parameters.name: MaxTotalRisk
parameters.description: 账户总风险敞口上限百分比
parameters.description_en: Maximum account total risk exposure percentage

parameters.name: AlertOnRiskLimit
parameters.description: 达到风险限制时是否弹出警报

parameters.name: SupportTrailingStop
parameters.description: 是否支持追踪止损功能

parameters.name: AutoCloseOnMaxRisk
parameters.description: 超过最大风险时是否自动平仓
parameters.description_en: Auto close positions on max risk breach

pros: 提供全面的风险监控和可视化面板，帮助交易者实时了解账户状态
可自定义风险参数如最大风险百分比和回撤限制，灵活性高
支持功能如追踪止损辅助和风险超限警报，增强交易纪律性
pros_en: Provides comprehensive risk monitoring and a visual info panel to help traders understand account status in real-time
Customizable risk parameters such as max risk percentage and drawdown limits offer high flexibility
Support features like trailing stop assistance and risk limit alerts enhance trading discipline
cons: 作为工具类EA，无法自动执行交易策略，依赖交易者手动操作
信息面板可能在图表上占用较多空间，影响其他指标或交易的视觉体验
缺乏高级风险分析功能如相关性风险或跨货币对敞口计算
cons_en: As a utility EA, it cannot automatically execute trading strategies and relies on the trader's manual operations
The info panel may occupy significant chart space, potentially interfering with the visual experience of other indicators or trades
Lacks advanced risk analysis features such as correlation risk or cross-pair exposure calculation
improvements: 增加跨货币对相关性分析和敞口聚合功能，提升风险管理维度
支持多账户统一监控和云端风险数据同步，便于管理多个交易账户
improvements_en: Add cross-pair correlation analysis and aggregated exposure functionality to enhance risk management dimensions
Support multi-account unified monitoring and cloud-based risk data synchronization for managing multiple trading accounts

risk_points: 该EA为纯工具性质，不进行自动交易，因此无直接交易风险
若启用自动平仓功能(AutoCloseOnMaxRisk)，可能在极端行情下导致非预期平仓
risk_points_en: The EA is purely a utility and does not trade automatically, so there is no direct trading risk
If the auto-close on max risk feature is enabled, it may cause unexpected position closures during extreme market conditions

summary_en: This EA is a risk management utility with an informational panel that monitors account risk metrics and provides support functionality. It does not open trades on its own but rather assists traders in managing exposure, tracking drawdown, and visualizing key account statistics through an on-chart info panel.
